newsitem.title: POLAND: Fatal dogbite reunites long-lost relatives.
newsitem.headline: Fatal dogbite reunites long-lost relatives.

text.p: A dog which bit a child to death in Poland indirectly led an Australian resident to find his long-lost family after 53 years.
Albin Ryszawa read of the incident in Australia's Polish press and noticed that the vet who later examined the dog shared his rare surname, PAP news agency reported on Wednesday.
Ryszawa, who was deported from Poland to work in Germany during World War Two and then emigrated to Australia, wrote to the vet Anna saying: "Maybe we are related."
Albin's family had heard nothing from him since 1943.
"Since then family members in Poland searched in vain for him through the Red Cross and other organisations," his step-brother's wife, Teresa Ryszawa, told PAP in the southeastern city Rzeszow.
"Eventually we got information that he was dead."
